# ACL Anthology

> ACL Anthology is the central repository for computational linguistics and natural language processing research papers, conference proceedings, and scholarly publications from major NLP conferences and their workshops.

ACL Anthology serves the computational linguistics research community by archiving papers from the Association for Computational Linguistics and affiliated conferences including ACL, AACL, IJCNLP, and EMNLP. The platform provides comprehensive access to research papers, proceedings, author pages, and bibliographic data in multiple formats.

## Key Topics

- Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL)
- Natural Language Processing (NLP)
- Computational Linguistics
- Conference Proceedings
- AACL (Asian Chapter)
- IJCNLP (International Joint Conference on NLP)
- Research Papers
- BibTeX Citation Format
- API Access
- Author Pages
- ORCID Integration
- Bulk Data Downloads
- Workshop Papers
- Bibliographic Data
- NLP Conferences

## Conference Venues & Proceedings

- [ACL Annual Meeting](https://aclanthology.org/venues/acl): ACL annual meeting venue archive with all conference proceedings and research papers
- [Asian Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics](https://aclanthology.org/venues/aacl): AACL conference venue archive with proceedings and research papers
- [ACL 2022 Proceedings](https://aclanthology.org/events/acl-2022): 60th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics from Dublin featuring research and workshop papers
- [ACL 2021 Proceedings](https://aclanthology.org/events/acl-2021): 59th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics and IJCNLP proceedings with workshop papers
- [ACL 2020 Proceedings](https://aclanthology.org/events/acl-2020): Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics 2020 including COVID-19 and vision research workshops
- [AACL 2025 Proceedings](https://aclanthology.org/events/aacl-2025): Asian Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics 2025 conference proceedings and papers
- [AACL 2023 Proceedings](https://aclanthology.org/events/aacl-2023): IJCNLP/AACL 2023 conference proceedings from Nusa Dua
- [AACL 2022 Proceedings](https://aclanthology.org/events/aacl-2022): Asian Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics 2022 conference and workshop papers
- [AACL 2020 Proceedings](https://aclanthology.org/events/aacl-2020): Asian Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics 2020 conference proceedings and workshop papers

## Data Access & APIs

- [Data Access Methods](https://aclanthology.org/faq/data): Documentation on data access methods including APIs, BibTeX, and bulk downloads for ACL Anthology content
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://aclanthology.org/faq): FAQ covering data access, APIs, citation formats, and bulk downloads from ACL Anthology

## Submission & Contribution Guidelines

- [Information for Submitters](https://aclanthology.org/info/contrib): Submission guidelines for conference chairs and proceedings publication process in ACL Anthology
- [Requesting Corrections](https://aclanthology.org/info/corrections): Guide for submitting metadata and PDF corrections to ACL Anthology
- [Author Pages Guide](https://aclanthology.org/info/author-pages): How-to guide for author pages and ORCID integration in ACL Anthology

## Community & Support

- [ACL Anthology Homepage](https://aclanthology.org): ACL Anthology central repository for computational linguistics research papers
- [Blog & Announcements](https://aclanthology.org/posts): ACL Anthology posts listing conference announcements and community updates
- [Feedback & Suggestions](https://aclanthology.org/faq/feedback): Instructions for submitting feedback and suggestions via GitHub issues
